scripts.wrappers:help: echo "Use 'make help' on Linux/macOS/WSL, or one of:" && echo "  npm run wrappers:test      - all 6 test suites" && echo "  npm run wrappers:lint      - syntax check all wrappers" && echo "  npm run wrappers:security  - scan for accidentally committed tokens" && echo "  npm run wrappers:info      - show repo info (git-platform-ops)" && echo "  npm run wrappers:auth      - show loaded tokens (git-platform-ops)" && echo "  npm run wrappers:notes     - show commits since last tag (release-ops)"
scripts.wrappers:test: bash tests/git-platform-ops/test.sh && bash tests/publish-ops/test.sh && bash tests/release-ops/test.sh && pwsh tests/git-platform-ops/test.ps1 && pwsh tests/publish-ops/test.ps1 && pwsh tests/release-ops/test.ps1
scripts.wrappers:test:bash: bash tests/git-platform-ops/test.sh && bash tests/publish-ops/test.sh && bash tests/release-ops/test.sh
scripts.wrappers:test:ps: pwsh tests/git-platform-ops/test.ps1 && pwsh tests/publish-ops/test.ps1 && pwsh tests/release-ops/test.ps1
scripts.wrappers:lint: bash -n scripts/git-platform-ops.sh && bash -n scripts/publish-ops.sh && bash -n scripts/release-ops.sh
scripts.wrappers:security: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { const out = require('child_process').execSync('grep -rEn \'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\' . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=tests || true').toString(); if (out.trim()) { console.error('FAIL: GitHub PAT found'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('OK: no real-looking tokens'); }" && git check-ignore .git-token && echo 'OK: .git-token is gitignored'
